name: Waldhof
beschreibung: Hotel Waldhof enjoys a peaceful setting in the Stubai Valley, surrounded by meadows and forests, about twelve minutes' walk from the village centre. The ambiance effortlessly blends traditional Tyrolean hospitality with a clean, contemporary design. Guests can expect comfortable, well-kept rooms and a restaurant serving regional culinary delights. The hotel is an ideal starting point for hikes and explorations into the surrounding mountain peaks.
